I have 2 different routines; let’s cover your first option if your primary desire is improving the texture & tone of the skin & stay tuned for the second option soon! 🤭  1 | an aha or glycolic acid onto the areas needed, wether that may be the entire leg or points like the knees & heels 2 | after allowing for your glycolic acid to fully absorb & dry into the skin, follow with water to redampen the skin & prepare for further moisturizers  3 | layer an UNFRAGRANCED body serum or essence containing skin-rebuilding ingredients, prequel half&half is my go-to for this 4 | allow your primer to absorb then follow with a primary moisturizer; being an UNFRAGRANCED body butter.
